requirements.description: The user wants the hotel to be near healthcare services for a residential senior care facility (RSA). The 'near' expression sets the threshold at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
User prefers energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are included. Classes E, F and G are excluded.

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is an explicit surface threshold. The resident capacity (30) and the energy class (D or better) are not REFERENCE COLUMNS, and proximity to healthcare is handled by the Location Agent, so none of them is added here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND healthcare >= 75 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 1600, healthcare >= 75, energy_class in A1-D, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates, ordered by distance. The requirement on tipologia_bene_immobile was ignored because that column is not in filterable_columns. Its property_type equivalent was not added because the extracted requirements did not name it on the allowed field. No predicate was added for the 30-resident capacity because no agent extracted it.
